s: Hakanat hasseuddot leshabbat ubo ch' seipim: leolam yashkim adam litroach ulehakin tzorke shabbat beereb shabbat babboqer, veremez laddabar shenneemar "vehaya bayyom hashshishshi vehekinu et asher yabiu", mashma lealtar sheyyabiu yakinu, vehahabaa hayeta babboqer, shenneemar "vayyilqetu oto babboqer babboqer". Veap al pi shehekin behashkama — mitzva sheyyosip gam beben hashshemashot, veremez laddabar shenneemar "vehaya mishneh" (kelomar, sheyyakinu shenit):
Veyesh leadam lemaet qetzat belimmudo beereb shabbat, vekol shekken bishar asaqayv, kede sheyyehe panuy lehakin tzorke shabbat, ella im ken hekin kebar beyom h', o sheyyesh lo mi sheyyakin lo:

Venohagin biqtzat meqomot shello liqboa yeshiba beereb shabbat, lepi shellimmud hayshiba hu dabar sheen lo qitzba, shergilin lepalpel, veshemma yimmasheku harbeh bepilpulam, velo yehe lahem penay achar kak lehakin tzorke shabbat. Abal mi shellomed dabar sheyyesh lo qitzba, im ragil lelomdo bekol yom — en lo lebattelo beereb shabbat. Veap dabar sheeno ragil lelomdo bekol yom, mikkol maqom im lomed im rabbim — al yebattelennu. Vaapillu keshellomed beyachid, im hu dabar shedderek lelomdo beereb shabbat, kegon perush rashi"y mipparashat hashshabua kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rp"h — yakol lilmod kedarko. Veim achar kak lo yimtza liqnot — azay lo yiqba limmudo babboqer, shehu zeman shemmotze liqnot. Veim lo yimtza liqnot achar hattepilla — azay yiqneh battechilla veachar kak yitpallel, ubilbad sheyyiqra qeriat shema miqqodem, shemma yaabor zemannah ad sheyyiqneh, abal hattepilla nimshak zemannah yoter. Veap sheyyesh lachush shemma yaabor gam zeman tepilla, mikkol maqom mitzva zo shel hakanat seuddot shabbat hi oberet bevadday, sheachar kak lo yimtza liqnot. Umikkol maqom, im hatztzibbur mitpalelin — al yiprosh mehem:

Apillu mi sheyyesh lo kamma abadim — yesh lo lehishtaddel lehakin beatzmo tzorke shabbat, shekken hu bekol hammitzvot: "mitzva bo yoter mibbishlucho". Vaapillu mi shehu adam chashub beyoter veen darko liqqach debarim min hashshuq, velo lehitasseq bimlakot shebbabbayit — chayyab lehishtaddel velaasot shum dabar mitztzorke hashshabbat beatzmo, shezzehu kebodo shel shabbat. Ugedole hachakamim hayu osim beatzmam melakot sheenan lepi kebodam, kede leharbot bikbod hashshabbat. Yesh mehem shehaya mechattek hayyaraq daq daq beatzmo. Veyesh mehem shehayu mebaqqeim etzim beatzmam. Veyesh mehem shehaya matztzit haur tachat haetzim beatzmo. Veyesh mehem shehaya metaqqen habbayit, umepanneh kele hachol umaknis kelim hatztzerikim leshabbat, ubeeseq zeh haya yotze veniknas tamid bebeto beereb shabbat, lehotzi kele hachol ulehaknis masot kele tashmish ubigde chopesh umine megadim, leharot kebod hashshabbat, shehu chashub alayv vechared likbodo keadam shemmeqabbel et rabbo bebeto, shehu mareh lo shehu chashub alayv vechared likbodo litroach uleharbot bishbilo. Umehem yilmod kol adam litroach beatzmo. Veal yomar "ek epgom kebodi", ki zehu kebodo shemmekabbed hashshabbat:

Yesh lizzaher lehashchiz hassakkin bekol ereb shabbat, ki zehu mikkebod hashshabbat, shemmekin atzmo laakila, veremez laddabar "vehekinu et asher yabiu", ubetebat "et" nirmaz hassakkin, milleshon "leittim ulemazmerot". Veomer "veyadata ki shalom oholeka", vedareshu chakamim zo hashchazat sakkin, ki im qeha habbarzel velo yukal lachtok — en zeh shelom bayit:
Tob lomar al kol dabar sheqqoneh "zehu likbod shabbat". Veken bekol mah shehu oseh tob lachshob sheoseh likbod shabbat:

Tob yoter liqnot beereb shabbat milliqnot beyom h'. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemashqin umine megadim vekayyotze bahem middebarim sheenam tzerikim hakana lahakinam sheyyihyu reuyim lahanaatam. Abal maakalim hatztzerikim adayin hakana — tob yoter liqnot beyom h', kede sheyyihyeh lo penay harbeh litroach bahakanatam, ulehitasseq bishar tzorke shabbat:
Yesh litom hattabshilim beereb shabbat. Vetob litom mikkol tabshil vetabshil:
